args.title: Summary: Ironbark freight pricing posts (main + companion)
args.body:
- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady (blog.ironbark.example/2026/freight).
- Fuel surcharges are now indexed to weekly diesel prices rather than fixed adjustments.
- Companion piece (insights.ironbark.example/freight/companion): shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
